about.title: Dinuba Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a family member in a traffic collision changes everything, and Dinuba families are not immune to this reality. Public records show 2 traffic deaths and 52 injuries from 36 injury collisions in the most recent year, with corridors like Avenue 416, Alta Avenue, N Alta Avenue, and El Monte Way among the more frequently traveled roads in town. California law gives certain surviving family members, starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, the right to pursue a wrongful death claim against the party responsible. These cases are separate from any criminal proceeding and follow their own civil process. LawProactive doesn't practice law; we simply connect grieving families in Dinuba with an independent attorney who can explain their options, evaluate what happened, and walk alongside them without any upfront cost. You focus on your family. Let someone else carry the legal weight for a while.

whyChoose.title: Why Dinuba Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Standing Rules Are Followed Carefully
items.desc: California limits who can bring a wrongful death claim, generally starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, then other dependents or heirs. An independent attorney can help determine exactly where your family fits before any claim moves forward.

items.title: The Two-Year Clock Is Tracked Closely
items.desc: Wrongful death claims in California generally must be filed within two years of the date of death, though claims against a government entity carry a much shorter deadline. Acting sooner rather than later helps preserve evidence and protect your family's rights.

items.title: Losses Beyond the Obvious Are Considered
items.desc: Recoverable losses can include funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance a loved one provided. An attorney can help make sure none of these losses are overlooked in your claim.

items.question: Who in my family is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: California law generally gives priority to a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may have standing. An independent attorney can review your specific family situation and explain your options.

items.question: How long do we have to file after losing someone in a Dinuba crash?
items.answer: In most cases, California allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim. If the responsible party is a government entity, such as a public road authority, the deadline is much shorter. It's best to speak with an attorney as soon as you're able.

items.question: Does it matter that our loss happened near roads like Avenue 416 or Alta Avenue?
items.answer: Location itself doesn't determine your legal rights, but the specific facts of the collision, including where and how it happened, matter for building a claim. An attorney can look closely at the circumstances of what happened in Dinuba and advise you accordingly.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim connected to a criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No, a wrongful death claim is a separate civil action from any criminal charges the driver may face. Your family can pursue compensation through the civil system regardless of the outcome of a criminal case.
